messages:
Anya (PM): Ok team — quick sync. We need to lock the rollout gates and sampling contracts for the observability console launch. Customers have asked for per-tenant trace sampling + cost guardrails. Hoping to decide thresholds and what constitutes an acceptance signal.

Sam (ENG): +1. My main constraints: backend can support variable sampling per-tenant but we need clear defaults to avoid cost spikes. Suggest default 0.5% traces, 10% error traces preserved, and adaptive uplift on error spikes.

Devon (SRE): Agree on defaults. Also need a hard circuit-breaker: if estimated daily trace tokens > X, revert to minimal sampling. Can we tie that X to a dollar budget?

Anya (PM): Yes we should map to $/day. Proposal: per-tenant telemetry budget config with three bands: sandbox ($5/day), standard ($50/day), enterprise (open). If estimated usage would exceed the band, automatically throttle sampling and send alert.

Tess (ML): For quality/acceptance, we need recall on error patterns. Suggested launch acceptance: 95% of customer error patterns must be visible in sampled traces at current sampling defaults (0.5%/10% retained). If not, we increase retention for the failing tenant during canary.

Sam (ENG): Implementation note: we'll add a sampling policy object and expose it via Console + API. Example config: 

```
{
  "sampling_policy": {
    "default_rate": 0.005,
    "error_preserve_pct": 0.10,
    "adaptive_rules": [
      {"trigger": "error_rate>2%", "uplift_to": 0.05, "duration": 3600},
      {"trigger": "latency_p95>1s", "uplift_to": 0.02, "duration": 1800}
    ]
  },
  "budget": {"daily_usd": 50}
}
```

Devon (SRE): That looks good. For circuit-breaker numeric: let's set an initial throttle point at $100/day per-tenant (ops can lower that). When throttle happens, we fallback to header-only sampling (no full spans) and mark tenant as throttled in console.

Anya (PM): Launch criteria checklist (draft):
- Default sampling policy implemented + Console UI to edit per-tenant (owner: Sam)
- Budget bands and automatic throttle + alerting (owner: Devon)
- Acceptance metric: 95% error-pattern recall in canary tenants (owner: Tess)
- Docs + customer-facing contract explaining sampling & billing (owner: Anya)

Tess (ML): For canary, recommend 3 tenants for 48h with diverse workloads: 1 high QPS, 1 bursty error-prone, 1 long-tail latency. We'll run recall evals and report.

Sam (ENG): Timeline: we can get policy + API in 2 sprints, console bits in sprint 3, throttle + alerting parallel with infra. Anyone opposed to that cadence?

Devon (SRE): Sounds reasonable. Ops needs a kill-switch in day-1 runbook. Add runbook step to revert sampling to 0.1% global if costs blow up.

Anya (PM): Noted. I'll draft the customer contract language about expected visibility at default rates and the budget bands.

ObservabilityBot: New PR opened: github.com/redwood/infer/pulls/1428 — "sampling-policy: add policy schema + adaptive rules" (assigned to @Sam).

Sam (ENG): Thanks bot. I'll pick up the PR and start console wireframes today.

Anya (PM): OK — next actions: Sam wires console + API schema, Devon configures budget alerting and kill-switch, Tess picks canary tenants. We'll reconvene Friday 10am to review canary plan. :thumbsup:
